focus: Q5 default-on integration needs, cost, risk

question: Q5
claim: Role choice is the first requirement: the same judge can be a regex replacement (3 calls per turn, ~1s serial), an adjudicator behind the existing gate (3 calls per firing turn; the gate fires on 7/110 = 6.4% here), or a shadow scorer (offline, no user effect). The 026 measurement only adjudicates the replacement role.
evidence: score-completion-claims.mjs:722-839 runJevArm (3 reruns + auth); census fires 7/110; 047 stdout "planned calls: jev=331"

question: Q5
claim: Latency budgets differ per surface and must bound the judge: Claude Stop is async with a 10s timeout, Codex/Devin Stop allow 10s, Pi turn_end delivers the advisory to the next turn (non-blocking), and the OpenCode session.idle plugin blocks the whole plugin host — the one surface a synchronous judge needs to budget carefully. The scorer's 90s CALL_TIMEOUT_MS must not be carried into hooks; the sentinel's own durability check runs at a 1.2s default.
evidence: .claude/settings.json:180-181 (timeout 10, async true); .codex/hooks.json:139 (timeout 10); .devin/hooks.v1.json:171; pi/completion-evidence.ts:81-97 (deliverAs nextTurn); sentinel:45-53 (host-blocking note), :90-94 (DEFAULT_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS 1200); score-completion-claims.mjs:78 (CALL_TIMEOUT_MS 90000)

question: Q5
claim: Availability and identity must be pinned: without jev on PATH or a credential the arm skips (exit 3 / skip lines), so default-on needs an explicit "judgment unavailable = fall through to regex-only" contract, the pinned jev 0.6.2 + model identity, and a requalify rule when the provider/model changes (the scorer already prints "requalify: model changed").
evidence: score-completion-claims.mjs:650-683 jevGate, :827-833 requalify; 047 stdout jev_version=0.6.2 provider=official model=jev-1.13.0

question: Q5
claim: Privacy is a hard gate: the judge forwards the turn tail verbatim to a provider (cli-jev: "Jev forwards the state verbatim"), the scorer requires --accept-payload, and 047 required "Jev gets no secret" with a secret scan of 0 matches — default-on needs operator consent plus a stripping pass, not a footnote.
evidence: .skilled/skills/cli-classifier/cli-jev/SKILL.md (When NOT to use: state is a secret); score-completion-claims.mjs:729 payload line, :971-974 accept-payload gate; 047 spec.md:120 REQ-003

question: Q5
claim: Cost is measurable and scales with turns: 331 calls per 110 rows (3 reruns + 1 auth), 24,735 estimated input tokens (~225/turn), p50 320ms / p95 391ms per call. Gate-replacement default-on is ~3 calls and ~1s serial per turn (~3,000 calls per 1,000 turns at these rates). Dedup is at the advisory layer (one per packet+message), not the judgment layer; a text-hash judgment cache would bound repeats.
evidence: 047 stdout payload/latency/planned-calls lines; calls.jsonl aggregation; sentinel:292-309 applyDedup

question: Q5
claim: The failure semantics a judge must inherit already exist: every adapter fails open, advisories never block (the Claude hook header: "NEVER emits {decision:block}"), kill switches exist (SYSTEM_COMPLETION_SENTINEL_DISABLED and the "completion" hook flag), and the log/dedup/retention sweep is bounded. Additions needed: a strict per-call timeout and a circuit breaker on repeated unavailability.
evidence: claude/completion-evidence-stop.cjs:17-20 (advisory rollout, never block); sentinel:489-547 (fail-open paths); hook-flags.cjs:63-69 (completion aliases); sentinel:321-340 (bounded log), :449-474 (sweep)

question: Q5
claim: The measurement gate before default-on is not passed: 047 says stop (margin) for replacement, and the passing threshold 0.7 replay is post-hoc at exact margin equality. Default-on requires a pre-registered role/threshold and a held-out keep with cost in the rule; the recorded rowsSha256/labelsSha256/calls.jsonl make an exact re-run possible.
evidence: 047 results.md:15; calls.jsonl threshold replay; score-completion-claims.mjs:991-1022 (report hashes)

question: Q5
claim: The highest-value low-risk first step is not the judge: fix the regex (vocabulary plus closing-position anchoring) at zero per-turn cost and no new privacy exposure, keep the judge offline/shadow, and add the sibling judgments (spec-folder resolution) to the same label workspace; the judge stays available for audits and adjudication once a pre-registered held-out keep exists.
evidence: F2-01..F2-03 replays; F4-03 spec-folder resolution; F5-04 privacy gate
